definition: A socially assistive robot (SAR) aids users through social engagement and support rather than through physical tasks and interactions..
details: A socially assistive robot (SAR) aids users through social engagement and support rather than through physical tasks and interactions.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Socially assistive robot.
